articles.title: Bitcoin steadies above $65,000 as Iran-Oman deal talk eases Hormuz concerns, lifts risk assets
articles.description: BTC rose to $65,209 and Nasdaq 100 index futures gained 0.45% on reports that Iran may strike a deal with Oman to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Bitcoin volatility is in meltdown, but downside protection still commands a premium
articles.description: Bitcoin’s BVIV volatility index hit the lowest level since 2025 as option demand collapsed. Still, overwriting surged and downside protection stayed pricey.

articles.title: A rare CME shift: Hedge funds abandon structural shorts to bet on a bitcoin rally
articles.description: CME leveraged funds turn net long as weak futures yields undermine the once-popular basis trade.

articles.title: U.S. CPI inflation, Securitize, Gemini among earnings reports: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Aug. 10

articles.title: Inside stablecoin firm BVNK’s journey to a $1.8B acquisition by Mastercard
articles.description: Early BVNK investor Concentric shares a fascinating inside view on the stablecoin startup’s journey and the eventual Mastercard deal.

articles.title: Robinhood brings crypto trading to UK in AI-powered all-in-one app
articles.description: The trading firm is also introducing “Robinhood Cortex Digests for Crypto,” a generative AI-powered widget that analyses breaking news and other data.

articles.title: Live updates: BTC above $65,000 even as the Senate punts the CLARITY Act to the fall
articles.description: The market rose even as the Senate left the crypto bill unpassed before its recess, with steady ETF inflows and a softer dollar doing more for prices than Washington.

articles.title: This bitcoin miner rejected BIP-110 despite mining through a pool that supported it
articles.description: Ocean, a bitcoin mining pool, had been backing BIP-110 by default. Simple Mining, a company that runs mining machines through Ocean, used software from the pool that lets individual miners choose for themselves and went the other way.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $65,000 with U.S. inflation data due this week
articles.description: Every major except XRP is green on the week, with BTC, ether and BNB each up nearly 3% as global stocks trade near a record.

articles.title: XRP is getting left behind in the crypto bounce even as ETFs keep attracting investor money
articles.description: The token fell 5% last week while BTC, ETH and SOL climbed.

articles.title: Is Clarity's delay a blessing in disguise?: State of Crypto
articles.description: The crypto industry is angry and disappointed that the Senate is not holding a procedural vote on the Clarity Act this month, but that isn't the worst possible outcome.

articles.title: Hyperliquid’s RWA perps boom is eating into the revenue that backs HYPE
articles.description: Revenue has fallen four quarters running while open interest hit a record high. The gap is a fee-sharing program that hands half the platform's volume to outside builders.

articles.title: Bitcoin investors pour $853 million into spot ETFs. BlackRock’s IBIT claims the bulk
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs recorded $853.54 million in net inflows last week, the strongest since mid-April, with BlackRock’s IBIT taking the bulk.

articles.title: Crypto is going through a massive dot-com style shakeout as over 100 projects fold in 2026
articles.description: An industry-wide reckoning is weeding out unsustainable startups, leaving behind only the protocols with real cash flow and actual users.

articles.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
articles.description: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits block 961,632 as the controversial BIP-110 soft fork attempt begins
articles.description: The proposal has scant support from bitcoin miners and influential commentators have also voiced their opposition.

articles.title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near
articles.description: Wildberries’ average price for hardware wallets fell 13% to 7,900 rubles, and M.Video broadened its range of products, though neither retailer identified the driving force behind the renewed demand.

articles.title: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad
articles.description: The rule applies to transfers above $10,000 and smaller transactions flagged as risky by exchanges.

articles.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
articles.description: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

articles.title: Why trillion-dollar asset manager T. Rowe Price put memecoins in its crypto ETF
articles.description: The $1.9 trillion asset manager says excluding established memecoins on principle would undermine its active approach to crypto investing.

articles.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
articles.description: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
articles.description: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

articles.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
articles.description: A new XRPL amendment proposal would let institutions encrypt token balances and transfer amounts while still giving issuers, auditors and regulators selective access.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
articles.description: If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated.

articles.title: Trump Media pulls back from crypto, scraps Crypto.com's CRO token treasury deal
articles.description: The Truth Social parent company is refocusing on media and its pending merger with a fusion energy firm, as the digital asset treasury boom has lost its steam.
